title: Ghen War
overview:
Do You Know Who Your Friends Are?

The Ghen, evil alien visitors, turn out to be a lot less friendly than their first impression. As a scientific-researcher and expert operator of a revolutionary combat hypersuit you are able to fight the Ghen. Use the awesome firepower, armor counter defenses and blinding speed to counter the evil empire that you and your crew are up against. Get ready to lean, fly and fight.

- Resist the Ghen planet by planet in 20 levels of first-person interstellar game play.
- Face combat in a true 360-degree battleground, surrounded by CD quality sound which dynamically adjusts to game play.

Help rescue mankind from the Ghen before it's too late!
